core_problem_solved: To provide a Java library for advanced console input handling, including line editing, history, and tab completion, similar to a standard Unix shell.
era_and_niche: A legacy Maven coordinate for the JLine library, which is a key component for building interactive command-line tools in Java.
reason_for_obsolescence: This Maven coordinate is **obsolete**. The project moved to a new groupId and has been significantly updated and modularized. The modern and actively maintained successor is **`org.jline:jline`**.
